_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.dashboard. Labels for the Auth Admin dashboard shell (Lumia DashboardShell) and the legacy in-app workspace switcher.
_meta.audience: Authenticated workspace administrators using the Auth Admin app.
_meta.tone: Concise, action-oriented. These strings appear in dense navigation, tooltips, and screen-reader names.

navigation._note: Top-level destination labels for the dashboard sidebar. Must match the Cross-App Navigation Vocabulary (xynes/xynes-infra/docs/research/ux-review/02-cross-app-navigation-vocabulary.md). Keep ≤ 20 chars after translation so labels fit collapsed sidebar tooltips and mobile bottom-bar slots.
navigation.apps: Auth-app destination: list of installed Xynes apps for the workspace.
navigation.accessControl: Auth-app destination: roles, permissions, RBAC. Shared label with CMS Console — keep wording identical.
navigation.security: Auth-app destination: 2FA, session management, security events.
navigation.integrations: Auth-app destination: workspace verified domains + global API keys. Shared label with CMS Console.
navigation.settings: Auth-app destination: workspace settings. Shared label with CMS Console.

shell._note: Lumia DashboardShell label bundle. Most strings are screen-reader-only (aria-label, aria-labelledby) — translators should keep them descriptive but short.

navigation.mainContent: Aria-label on the <main> landmark. Used by screen readers when jumping to main content.
navigation.sidebarScrollArea: Aria-label on the scrollable container inside the sidebar.
navigation.mobileMenu: Visible label on the mobile menu trigger button. Keep ≤ 8 chars.
navigation.openMobileMenu: Accessible name (aria-label) for the mobile menu icon-only button.

workspace.trigger: Aria-label on the workspace switcher trigger button.
workspace.fallbackName: Visible fallback shown if the active workspace has no name.
workspace.currentSection: Section header inside the workspace switcher menu, above the active workspace.
workspace.currentBadge: Pill on the active workspace row. Keep ≤ 10 chars after translation.
workspace.switchToSection: Section header above the list of other workspaces in the menu.
workspace.createAction: Menu item that opens onboarding to create a new workspace.
workspace.createUnavailableAction: Menu item label when workspace creation is disabled (e.g. plan limit). Pair with workspaceCreationDisabledMessage.

shell.workspaceCreationDisabledMessage: Tooltip / explanatory text shown when workspace creation is disabled.

profile.trigger: Aria-label on the avatar/profile menu trigger.
profile.profileAction: Menu item that opens the user's profile page.
profile.logoutAction: Menu item that signs the user out. Pair with /logout route.

logout._note: Transient toast copy shown when the user clicks Logout from the dashboard profile menu (BUG-AUTH-3b). The success toast appears immediately on click and remains visible through the redirect to /login (~500 ms). The error toast is shown only if the client-side navigation to /logout throws (rare — the /logout route handles signOut failures server-side).
logout.successTitle: Confirmation toast title when sign-out is initiated successfully. Keep ≤ 40 chars so it doesn't wrap on narrow viewports.
logout.successDescription: Confirmation toast description; explains the imminent redirect.
logout.errorTitle: Destructive toast title when client-side logout navigation fails. Keep ≤ 40 chars.
logout.errorDescription: Destructive toast description; actionable, no jargon.

notifications.open: Aria-label on the notifications drawer trigger (icon-only button).
notifications.tab: Tab/heading label for the notifications drawer.
notifications.titlePattern: Pattern for the notifications drawer header. ICU placeholder {unreadCount} is substituted at render time.
notifications.empty: Empty-state copy when the user has no notifications.
notifications.list: Aria-label on the notification list region.
notifications.todayGroup: Section heading for notifications dated today.
notifications.yesterdayGroup: Section heading for notifications dated yesterday.
notifications.unreadCountPattern: Pattern for the unread-count screen-reader announcement. ICU placeholder {unreadCount}.
notifications.deletePattern: Aria-label on each notification's delete button. ICU placeholder {title}.

userMenu.fallbackName: Displayed in the avatar tooltip + profile menu when the user has no display name and no email.
userMenu.fallbackEmail: Displayed under the user name when the user has no email and the consumer did not pass a profileSubtitle.

shell.footerNote: Static informational copy shown at the bottom of the dashboard sidebar.

workspaceSwitcher._note: Labels for src/components/workspace/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx — the LEGACY in-app workspace switcher kept for backwards compatibility. Production routes use the Lumia shell switcher (shell.workspace.* above). Translator: keep wording aligned with shell.workspace.* so the two surfaces don't diverge.
workspaceSwitcher.loading: Loading state label shown while workspaces are being fetched.
workspaceSwitcher.selectWorkspace: Trigger label shown when no workspace is currently selected.
workspaceSwitcher.ownerBadge: Pill rendered on a workspace row when the user has the workspace_owner role. Keep ≤ 6 chars.
workspaceSwitcher.currentWorkspaceSection: Section header in the menu, above the active workspace.
workspaceSwitcher.switchToSection: Section header above the list of other workspaces.
workspaceSwitcher.switchToAriaPattern: Aria-label on each switch-target row. ICU placeholder {name}.
workspaceSwitcher.triggerAvatarFallbackAlt: Avatar `alt` text shown when the active workspace is unknown (currentWorkspace is null). Translator: keep ≤ 12 chars.
workspaceSwitcher.triggerAvatarFallbackInitial: Single-character fallback shown inside the avatar when no current workspace exists. Translator: keep to 1–2 chars; symbol-only is fine.
